item.title: Instacart's CTO says AI made the company stop worrying about tech debt
item.description: Instacart is posing the provocative question: What if most of the work your engineers do today should, in fact, be done by machines?At VB Transform 2026, CTO Anirban Kundu argued that dev teams continue to waste their time on draining, repetitive, high-volume work; this should be absorbed by AI agents so that humans can focus on problems that require judgment, intent, and exception handling. item.title: Ozlo’s Sleepbuds 2 build on Bose’s sleep earbud legacy
item.description: Ozlo’s first major update to its sleep earbuds introduces longer battery life, improved connectivity, enhanced audio, and new sleep features as the startup continues the product line once abandoned by Bose.

item.title: The robot NASA hired to lift a orbital telescope is tumbling out of control
item.description: According to NASA, two of the three reaction wheels that control the spacecraft's alignment have failed, and there are problems with one of the spacecraft's thruster systems.

item.title: Meta drops major climate pledge after a decade of membership, says it is still committed to renewable energy
item.description: As it apparently expands reliance on fossil fuels, Meta has parted company with the RE100 initiative.

item.title: eBay reaches $56M settlement with e-commerce newsletter writers it terrorized in 2019
item.description: Ina and David Steiner inspired the ire of high-level eBay executives after occasionally criticizing the company in their newsletter. In 2019, a plot was concocted to intimidate the couple into halting their negative coverage.

item.title: Don’t like AI being forced on you? These librarians have the perfect first step
item.description: Libraries are now hosting ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops that help patrons disable forced AI features on various platforms. It’s built into your phone. Into your email. Into your search engine. Artificial intelligence is everywhere, to the point that avoiding it seems nigh on impossible—but there are ways to disable or ignore AI features, and librarians around the world are teaching their tech-averse patrons the ropes....
